title: When the Letter Burns Again
author: Beatrix Zhou
blurb: Rosalind Yarrow, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
